claim: relay's gate regression guard re-runs every earlier work package's deterministic checklist commands on each gate fire, not only the current gate's controls.

evidence.quote: re-run earlier WPs' deterministic checklist cmds

falsifier: A gate fire whose ledger records regression-item events for zero earlier controls, or gate code that filters the regression loop to the current WP only.

claim: At a late gate (contest.gate) a single fire re-evaluates 26 earlier controls as regression guards, measured from a real dense ledger.
falsifier: The command returns a small constant (e.g. <5) independent of gate depth.

claim: The per-fire regression count rises from 6 at survey.gate to 26 at the deeper contest.gate, measured in the same run.
falsifier: The two counts are equal, or survey.gate's count meets or exceeds contest.gate's — i.e. per-fire cost does not rise with depth.

claim: Across the whole sprint the ledger records 239 regression re-run verdicts.
falsifier: The ledger contains no regression-item verdicts, or a count materially different from 239.

claim: The regression loop re-runs every earlier control unconditionally, not only those with a recorded pass, so the re-run set is the full cumulative history of prior controls.

evidence.quote: this one re-runs every earlier control

falsifier: The loop filters earlier controls by recorded pass/keep-best, so failed or superseded controls are not re-run.

claim: Regression re-runs are the dominant share of grading: the ledger holds 239 regression-item verdicts against only 43 primary checklist-item verdicts.
falsifier: checklist-item verdicts equal or outnumber regression-item verdicts in the ledger.
